entries.title: John 13:1
segments: ¶Now before the feast of the Passover, when Jesus knew that His hour had come that He should depart from this world to the Father, having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the end.

entries.title: John 13:2
segments: And supper being ended, the devil having already put it into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's [son], to betray Him,

entries.title: John 13:3
segments: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was going to God,

entries.title: John 13:4
segments: rose from supper and laid aside His garments, took a towel and girded Himself.

entries.title: John 13:5
segments: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe [them] with the towel with which He was girded.

entries.title: John 13:6
segments: Then He came to Simon Peter. And [Peter] said to Him, "Lord, are You washing my feet?"

entries.title: John 13:7
segments: Jesus answered and said to him, "What I am doing you do not understand now, but you will know after this."

entries.title: John 13:8
segments: Peter said to Him, "You shall never wash my feet!" Jesus answered him, "If I do not wash you, you have no part with Me."

entries.title: John 13:9
segments: Simon Peter said to Him, "Lord, not my feet only, but also [my] hands and [my] head!"

entries.title: John 13:10
segments: Jesus said to him, "He who is bathed needs only to wash [his] feet, but is completely clean; and you are clean, but not all of you."

entries.title: John 13:11
segments: For He knew who would betray Him; therefore He said, "You are not all clean."

entries.title: John 13:12
segments: So when He had washed their feet, taken His garments, and sat down again, He said to them, "Do you know what I have done to you?

entries.title: John 13:13
segments: "You call me Teacher and Lord, and you say well, for [so] I am.

entries.title: John 13:14
segments: "If I then, [your] Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another's feet.

entries.title: John 13:15
segments: "For I have given you an example, that you should do as I have done to you.

entries.title: John 13:16
segments: "Most assuredly, I say to you, a servant is not greater than his master; nor is he who is sent greater than he who sent him.

entries.title: John 13:17
segments: "If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

entries.title: John 13:18
segments: ¶"I do not speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, 'He who eats bread with Me has lifted up his heel against Me.'

entries.title: John 13:19
segments: "Now I tell you before it comes, that when it does come to pass, you may believe that I am [He].

entries.title: John 13:20
segments: "Most assuredly, I say to you, he who receives whomever I send receives Me; and he who receives Me receives Him who sent Me."

entries.title: John 13:21
segments: When Jesus had said these things, He was troubled in spirit, and testified and said, "Most assuredly, I say to you, one of you will betray Me."

entries.title: John 13:22
segments: Then the disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom He spoke.

entries.title: John 13:23
segments: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of His disciples, whom Jesus loved.

entries.title: John 13:24
segments: Simon Peter therefore motioned to him to ask who it was of whom He spoke.

entries.title: John 13:25
segments: Then, leaning back on Jesus' breast, he said to Him, "Lord, who is it?"

entries.title: John 13:26
segments: Jesus answered, "It is he to whom I shall give a piece of bread when I have dipped [it]." And having dipped the bread, He gave [it] to Judas Iscariot, [the son] of Simon.

entries.title: John 13:27
segments: Now after the piece of bread, Satan entered him. Then Jesus said to him, "What you do, do quickly."

entries.title: John 13:28
segments: But no one at the table knew for what reason He said this to him.

entries.title: John 13:29
segments: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus had said to him, "Buy [those things] we need for the feast," or that he should give something to the poor.

entries.title: John 13:30
segments: Having received the piece of bread, he then went out immediately. And it was night.

entries.title: John 13:31
segments: ¶So, when he had gone out, Jesus said, "Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.

entries.title: John 13:32
segments: "If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify Him in Himself, and glorify Him immediately.

entries.title: John 13:33
segments: "Little children, I shall be with you a little while longer. You will seek Me; and as I said to the Jews, 'Where I am going, you cannot come,' so now I say to you.

entries.title: John 13:34
segments: "A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another; as I have loved you, that you also love one another.

entries.title: John 13:35
segments: "By this all will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another."

entries.title: John 13:36
segments: ¶Simon Peter said to Him, "Lord, where are You going?" Jesus answered him, "Where I am going you cannot follow Me now, but you shall follow Me afterward."

entries.title: John 13:37
segments: Peter said to Him, "Lord, why can I not follow You now? I will lay down my life for Your sake."

entries.title: John 13:38
segments: Jesus answered him, "Will you lay down your life for My sake? Most assuredly, I say to you, the rooster shall not crow till you have denied Me three times.
